title: Q-KIT-BREADTH-1: carry BREADTH-1 into the seed kit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/autonomy/system.json::not_in_kit
**Status:** open

SYSTEM-SPEC-1: the standing rule BREADTH-1 (Suggested ideas are broad and living, not single-field) is enforced only by the platform (deploy/launch-apps.mjs, doctrine/idea-bank.json, site/launchpath.test.mjs). A system built from the seed inherits the rule as an instruction but has no code here that enforces it.

Ship the check or loop that enforces BREADTH-1 into seed/ (a script under seed/scripts/, a tick step under seed/worker/src/, or a test under seed/tests/), add its probe to kit_enforcement in seed/autonomy/system.json, and remove BREADTH-1 from not_in_kit.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cd seed && python3 scripts/system.py --gaps prints no line for BREADTH-1, and python3 scripts/system.py --check passes.
